newsitem.title: USA: Nat'l Vision stake held by WisdomTree.
newsitem.headline: Nat'l Vision stake held by WisdomTree.

text.p: A group led by WisdomTree Associates L.P. said Thursday it holds a 5.6 percent stake, or 1,164,500 common shares, in National Vision Associates Ltd.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its stake includes 346,000 shares purchased between November 27 and December 31 at prices ranging from $3.87 to $4.51 a share.
The group said it holds the stake in the Lawrenceville, Ga.,-based eyecare products and services company for investment purposes.
WisdomTree is a New York-based private investment fund.
